name: Activation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All members are NK/T cell signatures or positive regulation of NK/T cytotoxicity and cytokine output; unlike confusables it lacks negative regulation, KIR, MHC-Ib and granzyme terms.

name: Pre-replicative complex assembly and replication stress checkpoint
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-RC formation, its E2F/Orc1 control and ATR replication checkpoint signalling, which the E2F-target and replication-initiation confusables lack.

qualifier: lipoxygenase products and inherited enzyme/transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis and fatty acid metabolism disorders
rationale: Members are fatty acid/eicosanoid metabolism, lipoxygenase/hepoxilin synthesis and inherited CYP/SLC defects, versus confusables centred on omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase P450 routes.

name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal glucocorticoid secretion and stress response
rationale: Members are CRH/ACTH/cortisol secretion and glucocorticoid responses to stress, distinguishing it from feeding, growth hormone, neuropeptide and behaviour confusables.

name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signalling, their HSE-causing deficiencies, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-beta control, unlike RIG-I/helicase, IRF3/IRF7 and ADAR editing confusables.

name: Stress, fear and social or reproductive behaviour
rationale: Members are corticosterone/CRH stress responses plus aggression, mating, parental, drinking and ethanol behaviours, unlike confusables focused on hormone secretion, neuropeptide signalling, drug reward or sleep.

name: Chaperonin folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span TRiC/CCT and chaperone folding, refolding, aggregate handling and degradation control, while confusables lack the chaperonin folding arm and centre on ubiquitin enzymology, RQC or organelle autophagy.

name: Glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members are hexose phosphorylation, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, glycogen breakdown and alanine metabolism, distinct from confusables on glycogen synthesis/storage disease and fructose metabolism.

name: Regulation of nuclear protein import and export
rationale: All three members regulate protein import into or export from the nucleus, whereas confusables concern nuclear pore complex assembly and RNA export.

qualifier: activity-dependent CREB signalling and synaptic translation
name: Activity-dependent synaptic plasticity, memory and synaptic translation
rationale: Members are LTP/LTD, memory, CaMK-CREB/NPAS4 transcription and synaptic translation control; translation and memory distinguish it from cAMP- and AMPK-centred confusables.

name: Choline, carnitine and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism
rationale: Members are choline, carnitine and SAM metabolism with MAT1A/AHCY defects; SAM separates it from choline/creatine and fatty acid confusables, choline/carnitine from methionine salvage.

name: Xenobiotic, steroid and flavonoid glycoside metabolism
rationale: Members are xenobiotic/steroid metabolism, sulfonation and cytochrome metabolism plus flavone metabolism and glycoside transport, which the drug ADME and toxin confusables lack.

qualifier: CDC42-driven, with suppression of integrin-matrix adhesion
name: CDC42-driven protrusion and suppression of integrin-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members are CDC42/Rho GTPase control of lamellipodia, pseudopodia and actin polymerisation with negative regulation of integrin adhesion and spreading, unlike epithelial migration, invadopodia or WASP/WAVE confusables.

qualifier: oxysterol routes and hereditary spastic paraplegia
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegia
rationale: Members are 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis, cholesterol catabolism and CYP7B1/CYP2U1/SLC33A1/CYP27A1 neurological disorders, unlike classic 7alpha-hydroxylase or peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics and autophagosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members are mitophagy, pexophagy/reticulophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion and targeting, and autophagosome-lysosome fusion; the mitochondrial arm distinguishes it from aggrephagy/CMA and endolysosomal confusables.

name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC silencing
rationale: Members are miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-mediated silencing; siRNA processing distinguishes it from mRNA decay and miRNA target-regulation confusables.

qualifier: cytosolic calcium clearance via sodium-calcium exchange
name: Cardiac cytosolic calcium clearance and sodium-calcium exchange
rationale: Members cover ion transport, calcium sequestration, Na/Ca exchange and cardiomyocyte membrane potential and contraction, unlike ryanodine-release and SERCA/relaxation confusables.

qualifier: complex III and IV, inner membrane insertion
name: Complex III and IV assembly, inner-membrane protein insertion
rationale: Members are complex III/IV and respirasome assembly plus protein insertion into the inner membrane, unlike complex I/ATP synthase assembly and electron transport confusables.

name: NOD-like receptor bacterial sensing and JNK/p38 regulation
rationale: Members are NOD1/2, inflammasome and ALPK1 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan with TAK1-driven JNK/p38 control, unlike TLR/IKK/NF-kB confusables.

core: ER lipid transfer and membrane traffic
name: Endoplasmic reticulum lipid transfer and ER-Golgi membrane traffic
rationale: Members cover ER-Golgi phospholipid/PI transfer, PI synthesis, ER-membrane tethering, cholesterol transport and Golgi vesicle traffic, unlike ER-shaping, phosphoinositide-signalling or glycolipid-transport confusables.

name: Mycotoxin and xenobiotic detoxification with steroid metabolism
rationale: Members are aflatoxin/mycotoxin/polyketide and toxin catabolism plus xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, sulfonation; mycotoxin terms separate it from drug-ADME and flavonoid confusables.

name: Xenobiotic efflux and canalicular bile secretion
rationale: Members are cellular/blood-brain-barrier xenobiotic export and ABCB4/ABCB11 bile secretion, unlike bile acid synthesis, organic anion uptake or phospholipid flippase confusables.

name: DNA double-strand break sensing and classical end joining
rationale: Members are DSB sensing, ATM recruitment and classical NHEJ, whereas confusables centre on end resection, homologous recombination and alternative end joining.

name: Histone and DNA methylation in epigenetic silencing
rationale: Members are histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, DNA methylation, imprinting, X inactivation and chromatin remodeller complexes, versus BAF remodelling, deacetylation and nucleosome assembly confusables.

qualifier: G1/S progression and replication initiation control
name: Cell cycle G1/S progression and replication initiation control
rationale: Members are cell cycle/E2F signatures, G1/S promotion and regulation of mitotic DNA replication initiation, unlike pre-RC/ATR checkpoint and DNA repair confusables.
